rule: fix failing contrast by adjusting L only
description: Move foreground L away from its rendered background while keeping C and H unchanged then verify with APCA or WCAG

rule: inputs expose persistent visible labels
description: Pair every input with a label or aria-label that survives entry and keep placeholder as supplement only

rule: actions use button navigation uses a Link
description: Use button for actions and a or Link for navigation never div onClick to preserve keyboard Cmd-click and middle-click

rule: icon-only buttons carry aria-label
description: Expose aria-label on every icon-only button. Text-labeled buttons exempted

rule: never strip outline without focus-visible replacement
description: Flag outline-none unless replaced by a visible focus-visible ring with contrast. Non-interactive text exempted

rule: set min-width 0 on flexible children
description: Add min-width 0 to flex and grid items containing text media or truncation so intrinsic content cannot force overflow

rule: responsive images carry width height plus srcset
description: Define explicit width and height to prevent CLS and add sizes and srcset when fluid. Fixed-size raster exempted from srcset

rule: ALWAYS author new colors in oklch()
description: Write every new interface color as oklch() and do not add new hex rgb hsl values. currentColor inherit transparent and vendor-owned hex stay untouched

rule: clamp out-of-gamut colors by reducing chroma
description: Keep L and H fixed and lower C to the sRGB maximum for that L hue with vivid P3 value only inside color-gamut p3

rule: components use semantic tokens never primitives
description: Style components with purpose aliases like card or primary-foreground and keep raw scales purpose-free in root

rule: use stable unique keys for list items
description: Set keys from stable ids with key set to item id. Index keys only for static never-reordered lists

rule: dialogs trap focus escape and restore
description: Confine Tab inside modals and close on Escape with focus returned to the trigger. Non-modal popovers allowing outside interaction excepted

rule: use logical properties for direction
description: Write spacing and positioning with margin-inline padding-inline inset and text-align start or end so RTL layouts work with no overrides

rule: prefer container queries for component scope
description: Set component breakpoints with container queries on parent width and reserve media queries for page-level breakpoints only

rule: build palettes with fixed lightness steps
description: Use even lightness steps with constant hue per ramp rebuilt when hue drifts past 10 degrees and clamped from 0.05 to 0.95 so ends keep gradation

rule: enforce state precedence disabled loading active focus hover
description: Let higher states fully suppress lower state visuals with hover never shown on disabled or loading controls

rule: announce async updates via aria-live
description: Expose toasts validation and list updates through polite or assertive live regions with focus left in place. Decorative silent updates exempted

rule: type UI component props strictly with no any
description: Declare UI component props events and returns with precise readonly types and strict null checks with isolated third party adapters as the only exception

rule: provide skip-to-content link
description: Make the first focusable element a skip link targeting main content and visible on focus. Single-screen widgets without a main landmark excepted

rule: virtualize lists past 50 items
description: Virtualize or paginate lists past 50 items and contain overlays with overscroll behavior. Small static lists exempted

rule: never measure layout during render
description: Keep bounding-rect and offset reads out of render and batch reads with writes with flex and grid preferred over JS measurement

rule: memoize expensive subtrees
description: Wrap pure heavy lists and charts in memo with shallow-equal props. Cheap leaf text exempted

rule: pair Suspense regions with error boundaries
description: Give every lazy boundary an error boundary showing retry and support action. Fatal boot errors may bubble to the app shell

rule: size fluid type with clamp
description: Define headings and body with clamp spanning mobile to desktop so text scales with no extra breakpoints

rule: balance-wrap short text
description: Apply text-wrap balance to headings captions and cards under four lines to avoid orphan words and ragged breaks

rule: offset anchored headings below sticky chrome
description: Give jump targets scroll-margin-top around 80px so sticky headers never cover the target

rule: keep hover disclosures hoverable and keyboard-dismissable
description: Show triggered tooltips and popups on focus as well as hover and let pointer rest on them with Escape to dismiss and persistence until dismissal or invalidation

rule: group related choices with fieldset and legend
description: Wrap radio and multi-part groups in fieldset with legend exposing the group relationship natively. Genuinely independent controls excepted

rule: declare autocomplete purpose on personal inputs
description: Add autocomplete tokens like name email tel to personal inputs while product wording stays. Inputs outside the recognized list excepted

rule: tag page and passage language with lang
description: Mark the default language with lang and tag every language change so assistive tech pronounces correctly. Proper names technical terms and indeterminate passages stay exempt

rule: keep console free of errors and warnings
description: Ship production builds with zero console errors and no failed requests. Logged warnings with tracked fallback and user-safe degradation excepted

rule: stabilize callbacks sent to memoized children
description: Wrap callbacks passed to memo components with useCallback and minimal deps. Inline handlers fine for non-memoized leaves

rule: hoist static objects out of render props
description: Hoist style objects options and column defs out of render or memoize them. Inline literals fine for unmemoized static UI

rule: scope context providers to consuming subtrees
description: Wrap only the subtree consuming the value and split state and dispatch contexts. Global theme and auth stay at root

rule: wrap long strings safely
description: Apply overflow-wrap anywhere with hyphens where appropriate and break-word only for URLs code or unspaced tokens so long strings never cause horizontal scroll

rule: preserve media ratio with aspect-ratio
description: Set aspect-ratio such as 16 to 9 on video hero and skeleton slots with object-fit cover so late-loading media never shifts layout
